transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I keep taking on more and more projects and plans at once, and I can’t seem to slow myself down even though everything in my life is starting to fall apart. My sister and neighbor really encouraged me to come in because my commitments and money management are just spiraling out of control.
Do you feel an intense excitement, euphoria, or a sense of invincibility when you take on these multiple projects and plans?

Yes, absolutely—most days I have this buzzing, giddy excitement about all my projects, and I feel like I'm finally operating at the high level I was always meant to. But if anyone interrupts me or questions my plans, I get incredibly irritable and just snap at them.

How long have you been experiencing this pattern of intense excitement, taking on multiple projects, and irritability, is it a persistent trait or has it been episodic with clear periods of normal functioning in between?

This has been building and spiraling for about three months, ever since I unexpectedly lost my illustration contracts and a teaching course. It is definitely episodic, as I've had much calmer stretches of life before this where I functioned normally without any of these intense feelings.

Have you experienced any periods of abnormally depressed mood or loss of interest in activities that you once enjoyed, either before or after these episodes of intense excitement and increased activity?

No, I haven't really experienced periods of deep depression or lost interest in the things I love. My main issue has been this recent overwhelming speed, overcommitting to everything, and the stress of it all rather than feeling down.

Have you experienced any significant impairment in social or occupational functioning, or required hospitalization, due to these episodes of increased activity and excitement, or have they been manageable despite causing some problems?

It definitely isn't manageable anymore, though I haven't been hospitalized. I’ve missed critical deadlines, confused my client invoices, fallen behind on my taxes, and heavily strained my relationship with my sister. I feel like things are completely spiraling out of control and risking my entire livelihood.
Have you experienced any psychotic symptoms, such as hallucinations or delusions, during these episodes of intense excitement and increased activity?

Yes, lately I've been completely convinced that the IRS and one of my old clients are secretly coordinating to sabotage me and push me into bankruptcy. This paranoid feeling only happens when I'm in these high-energy states, and I've never experienced things like hearing or seeing things that aren't there.

Can you tell me more about how long these episodes of intense excitement and increased activity typically last, and do you have any periods where you return to a normal mood and functioning in between these episodes?

This current high-energy state has been building and spiraling continuously for about three months, ever since my contracts were canceled. Before this episode, I had long, calm stretches in my life where my mood and functioning returned completely to normal. During those normal times, I didn't experience any of these racing thoughts or paranoid feelings.

Can you estimate how many of these episodes of intense excitement and increased activity you've experienced in the past year, and do you notice any pattern or trigger that leads to the start or end of these episodes?

I'm really not sure about other episodes over the past year, as I've been so completely focused on what's been happening these last three months. But this current spiral was definitely triggered when I suddenly lost my illustration contracts and my adjunct teaching course was canceled.

You mentioned this current episode has lasted about three months, but can you think of any previous episodes in your life where you experienced similar intense excitement, increased activity, and then a return to normal functioning, and if so, how long those episodes typically lasted?

I'm not really sure, but I don't think I've ever experienced an episode like this in the past. While I've had normal ups and downs, my life has mostly consisted of much calmer stretches before this current period. I certainly haven't had previous episodes of this intensity or duration.

Can you clarify if you have had any previous episodes similar to this three-month episode, and if so, were they shorter, or is this the first time you've experienced such a prolonged period of intense excitement and increased activity?

I'm really not sure, and I haven't thought much about whether I've had similar episodes in the past. This is definitely the first time I've felt this completely overwhelmed and out of control. Right now, I'm just trying to focus on how to handle my current situation.

Can you try to recall if you've had any shorter periods, maybe a few days or a week, where you felt similarly excited, energetic, and took on a lot, but then returned to normal, before this three-month episode started?

I don't recall having any shorter episodes like this in the past. While I've had calmer periods of life, this level of intense energy and taking on so many projects is entirely new and hasn't happened in shorter bursts before.

You've mentioned this current episode has lasted about three months, but to clarify, have you had any distinct periods of normal functioning in between episodes of intense excitement and increased activity, or has this been a continuous state since it started?

Since those contracts ended three months ago, this state has been completely continuous and non-stop without any breaks or normal days. While I definitely had calmer, normal periods in my life before this, these past three months have just been a constant, building spiral. I haven't had any moments of normal functioning since it started.
Have you experienced any periods where your intense excitement and increased activity lasted less than a week, or have all your episodes, including this current one, lasted several weeks to months?

No, I haven't had any short periods like that lasting less than a week. This current episode has been going on continuously for about three months, ever since my contracts were canceled. It has just been a sustained, building spiral during this entire time.

You mentioned this episode has lasted about three months, but to confirm, is this the longest episode you've experienced, and have you had any episodes in the past that were significantly shorter or longer than this one?

Yes, this current episode has been going on for about three months now. I'm really not sure and haven't kept track of whether I've had similar episodes in the past that were shorter or longer. This is just the most severe and overwhelming period I can ever remember experiencing.
Can you confirm whether you have experienced any episodes of intense excitement and increased activity that lasted less than 4 days, which would be distinct from this current 3-month episode?

I'm really not sure and I don't recall having any short, distinct episodes like that in the past. My mind has been entirely focused on this current three-month period and the calmer, stable stretches of life I had before all of this started.
